## Problem and behavior

Describe the user problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List checks run and results, plus any checks omitted and why. Include desktop smoke tests for native behavior and screenshots for visible changes (light/dark and keyboard behavior where relevant).

## Review notes

- User docs and `docs/release-notes.md` Unreleased entry updated when applicable.
- Workspace compatibility, backup/restore, and security impact described when applicable.
- New dependencies or copied code/assets identified with licensing and attribution.
